ov: Rodents with slender bodies, long bushy tails and large eyes. The family includes tree squirrels, ground squirrels such as chipmunks and prairie dogs, and flying squirrels.
len: 10–14 cm (pygmy squirrels) to 1.27 m (giant flying squirrel)
wt: 12–26 g (pygmy squirrels) to 8 kg or more (marmots)
rg: Native to the Americas, Eurasia and Africa, and introduced by people to Australia.
df: Mainly seeds and nuts, plus fruit, fungi and green plants. Many also eat insects, and some take eggs and small animals.
fx: In temperate regions, early spring is the hardest time for squirrels, because the nuts they buried start to sprout.
